title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Carroll University
description: Discover the essential late-night food and study spots that define the student experience at Carroll University in Waukesha.

cards.title: Crave at Carroll
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Campus Dining
cards.notes: Located in Frontier Hall, this spot offers a full menu for dine-in or carry-out until 9 p.m. daily, accepting Carroll Cash and meal plans.
cards.short_summary: A primary on-campus dining location in Frontier Hall open until 9 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Crave at Carroll in Frontier Hall is open 7 a.m.-9 p.m. daily and accepts meal plans and Carroll Cash.
cards.source_title: Dining Services Locations and Information - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 9:00 PM during the academic year.

cards.title: Stone Creek Coffee at Todd Wehr
cards.subtitle: Library Study Fuel
cards.notes: Fuel your late-night study sessions at the Todd Wehr Memorial Library location, open until 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A local coffee favorite situated inside the Todd Wehr Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Stone Creek Coffee in Todd Wehr Memorial Library is open 7:30 a.m.-9 p.m. Monday-Thursday.
cards.source_title: Dining Services Locations and Information - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Thursday; limited weekend hours.

cards.title: Campus Center
cards.subtitle: The Center of Everything
cards.notes: The hub for student life, the Campus Center stays open until 11:30 p.m. on weekdays and 12:30 a.m. on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: The central student hub offering late-night access to lounges and resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center is open Monday–Thursday until 11:30 p.m. and Friday–Saturday until 12:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:30 PM Sun-Thu and 12:30 AM Fri-Sat.

cards.title: Toppers Pizza
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Topperstix
cards.notes: A classic Wisconsin late-night tradition, this location serves signature Topperstix and pizza until 1:55 a.m. for pickup and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night pizza chain known for its cheesy Topperstix.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers Pizza on N Grandview Blvd has online ordering hours until 1:55 AM.
cards.source_title: Toppers Pizza Waukesha North - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open for delivery and pickup until 1:55 AM daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Sunset
cards.subtitle: Drive-Thru Fourth Meal
cards.notes: Located just south of campus, the drive-thru at this Sunset Drive location remains open until 2 a.m. for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A reliable fast-food option with late-night drive-thru hours near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 405 W Sunset Dr features drive-thru hours until 2:00 AM on Mondays (and similar late hours daily).
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Waukesha, WI - 405 W Sunset Dr

cards.title: McDonald's on Moreland
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Golden Arches
cards.notes: This East Moreland Blvd location provides a 24-hour drive-thru option for students needing a meal at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast-food staple located a short drive from the university.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 2340 E Moreland Blvd operates a 24-hour drive-thru.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Waukesha, WI at 2340 E Moreland Blvd | McDonald's

cards.title: Kwik Trip
cards.subtitle: Wisconsin's 24/7 Pantry
cards.notes: A regional favorite for 24-hour snacks, fresh fruit, and Glazers donuts, perfect for a quick midnight supply run.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and gas station offering fresh food and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Kwik Trip locations, such as the one on River Valley Rd, are open 24 hours a day.

cards.title: Einstein Bros. Bagels
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Dining
cards.notes: Located in the Campus Center, Einstein's serves sandwiches and coffee until 7 p.m. daily, providing an early evening dining option.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus bagel and coffee shop located in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein Bros. Bagels in the Campus Center is open until 7 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Dining Services Locations and Information - Carroll University

cards.title: Jimmy John's
cards.subtitle: Freaky Fast Delivery
cards.notes: The Grand Avenue location offers quick sandwich delivery to campus until 10 p.m., ideal for late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich shop providing fast delivery and pickup options near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jimmy John's on Grand Ave in Waukesha typically serves until 10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Jimmy John's Locations in Waukesha, Wisconsin
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM for delivery and pickup.

cards.title: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Breakfast
cards.notes: A classic choice for late-night breakfast or pie, this casual diner is a short drive from campus and open until 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A family-style restaurant known for all-day breakfast and bakery items.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery locations in the region typically operate until 10:00 PM or later.
